title: 第十三章 人族和妖族第十四章 孟川登场
lines: 孟川他们所有道院弟子，还有那些大家族少年们都认真盯着看。他们将来几乎都是要服兵役的，这是逃避不了的。
“猪妖。”一位壮实少年左手盾牌右手大斧，一跃而上落在擂台上，盯着擂台另一边的猪妖。
猪妖盯着这位人族少年，咧嘴露出那一嘴锋利牙齿，发出低沉的“嗬嗬~~~”怪声，跟着陡然就冲出。
轰！
猪妖横冲直撞，速度极快。
“好快的速度。”
“这速度都媲美脱胎境了，书中写的果真没错，就算是最普通的小妖，都有媲美脱胎境的身体。”观看的众多道院弟子们都心中一紧，这已经是最普通的小妖了。
那少年‘张如尚’却是在对方即将碰撞的刹那，就已经退避到一旁，左手撑盾，同时右手一斧就怒劈向猪妖的下盘。
猪妖冲的太快，变向不及，但也是撑起右臂，右手肘‘擦’了下盾牌，少年张如尚就感觉汹涌力量冲击而来，情不自禁往后踉跄退了三步，手中那一斧也劈了个空。
“书中说，妖怪的身体强横，但战斗技艺比我们差，这点没错。”少年张如尚暗道，“可也更野蛮，我不能犯错，还得寻找机会，一举将它击杀的机会。”
“哼~~~”猪妖眼神越加疯狂，继续凶猛冲杀过来。
只见擂台上。
猪妖蛮横之极，他力气极大，速度也极快。即便随意一招擦碰到那人族少年，人族少年都被震得往后退。可人族少年也坚韧的很，步伐精妙，从来不硬碰硬，盾牌卸力也厉害。完全挡住猪妖一次次冲杀，显然滑溜的很。
“你们张家这小辈，这一手盾牌用的真不错。”
“完全防住了，没给猪妖一点机会。”
“不知道这猪妖有没有藏着一手。”五大家族的高层也在聊天。
忽然——
猪妖挥动的爪子，速度陡然涨了一截。
这有些出乎少年张如尚的意料，他脸色大变，连猛地一缩头，缩在盾牌后。
“嘭。”爪子怒劈在盾牌上，虽然盾牌倾斜角度让猪妖有些难受，可这一爪子依旧令盾牌飞起，那少年张如尚更是借力更快倒飞，飞出了擂台范围。
刚落在擂台外地面上，张如尚就吐了一口血，脸色发白。
“好阴险，竟然隐藏实力。”张如尚盯着擂台上的猪妖。
“算你逃得快。”猪妖低沉说了句。
“什么？”
“这猪妖竟然还隐藏了一手？”
“关键时刻施展出来，这就可怕了。”一个个道院弟子却有些心头发紧，也就第一个上场的是谨慎擅守的张如尚。换一个道院弟子说不定就吃大亏。
“还真藏了一手。”五大家族高层们闲聊着也轻松的很，他们都有战场和妖怪厮杀的经历。很清楚妖怪们是何等的凶残！眼前的场面，对他们都是很‘温柔’的场面了。
那位看着名单的朝廷官员也朗声笑道：“妖怪都是开启了灵智，他们也会算计，不可小觑。好了，下一个，春雨道院夏侯竦。”
擂台上。
猪妖继续站在那，低沉和一旁断臂男子道：“第一场我赢了。
“连赢三场你就可以回牢里。”断臂男子说道。
content_en:
Meng Chuan, all the Taoist disciples, and the young men from the big families stared at him seriously. Almost all of them will have to perform military service in the future, which is unavoidable.
"Pig demon." A sturdy young man jumped up and landed on the ring with a shield in his left hand and a big ax in the right hand, staring at the pig demon on the other side of the ring.
The pig demon stared at the human boy, grinned and revealed its sharp teeth, made a low "hoho~~~" sound, and then suddenly rushed out.
boom!
The pig demon runs rampant and is very fast.
"What a speed."
"This speed is comparable to that of the Reborn Realm. What is written in the book is indeed correct. Even the most ordinary little demon has a body comparable to the Reborn Realm." Many Taoist disciples who watched felt their hearts tighten. This was already the most ordinary little demon.
The young man 'Zhang Rushang' had already stepped aside at the moment when the opponent was about to collide. He supported the shield with his left hand and at the same time slashed angrily at the lower body of the pig demon with an axe with his right hand.
The pig demon rushed too fast and couldn't change direction, but he still raised his right arm and 'grazed' the shield with his right elbow. The young man Zhang Rushang felt the impact of the surging force. He couldn't help but staggered back three steps, and the ax in his hand was also struck empty.
"The book says that monsters are physically powerful, but their fighting skills are worse than ours. This is true." Young Zhang Rushang secretly thought, "But it is also more savage. I can't make mistakes, and I have to look for opportunities to kill it in one fell swoop."
"Hmph~~~" The pig demon's eyes became more and more crazy, and he continued to charge fiercely.
All I saw was the arena.
The pig demon is extremely arrogant, he is extremely strong and extremely fast. Even if he bumped into the human boy with a casual move, the human boy would be shocked back. But the human race boy is also very tough, his steps are exquisite, he never confronts the opponent head-on, and his shield force is also great. Completely blocking the pig demon's charge again and again, it was obviously very slippery.
"You, the younger generation of the Zhang family, are really good at using this shield."
"Completely guarded against it, didn't give the pig demon a chance."
"I wonder if this pig demon has a hidden agenda." The top leaders of the five major families were also chatting.
suddenly——
The speed of the pig demon's waving claws suddenly increased.
This was somewhat beyond the expectations of young Zhang Rushang. His expression changed drastically, and he suddenly shrank his head and hid behind his shield.
"Bang." The claw struck the shield angrily. Although the tilt of the shield made the pig demon feel uncomfortable, the claw still caused the shield to fly up. The young man Zhang Rushang used the force to fly upside down faster and flew out of the ring.
As soon as he landed on the ground outside the ring, Zhang Rushang vomited a mouthful of blood and turned pale.
"So insidious, you actually hide your strength." Zhang Rushang stared at the pig demon on the ring.
"You can escape quickly." The pig demon said in a low voice.
"What?"
"This pig demon actually has a secret secret?"
"It would be terrifying if you show it at the critical moment." Each of the Taoist disciples was a little nervous, and the first one to come on stage was the cautious and disciplined Zhang Rushang. Another Taoist disciple might have suffered a big loss.
"You really have a hidden skill." The senior leaders of the five major families chatted easily. They all had experience of fighting monsters on the battlefield. We know very well how ferocious the monsters are! The scene in front of them was a very 'gentle' scene for them.
The court official who was looking at the list also laughed loudly and said: "Monsters are all spiritually enlightened, and they can also scheme, so they should not be underestimated. Okay, next one, Xia Houchong of Chunyu Taoist Academy."
In the arena.
The pig demon continued to stand there, and said in a low voice to the man with a broken arm beside him: "I won the first game.
“Win three games in a row and you can go back to jail. "said the man with a broken arm.
